description: This file contains extension methods for the ISiloBuilder interface, specifically for configuring fault injection and transactional state storage in Orleans silos, related to controlled fault injection for testing purposes.

classes.name: SiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure fault injection and transactional state storage.

methods.name: UseControlledFaultInjectionTransactionState
methods.description: Configures the silo builder to use the controlled fault injection transaction state, enabling fault injection for testing.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Adds fault injection Azure Table transactional state storage to the silo builder with default provider name.

methods.name: AddFaultInjectionAzureTableTransactionalStateStorage
methods.description: Adds fault injection Azure Table transactional state storage with a specified name and configuration options.
